traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Lacistemataceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; stipules present; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers in racemes, in spikes or in catkins; perianth tepals or absent; fruit capsule; stamens 1; carpels 2 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
